text:
elaine-finance: FYI Quantiva flagged a midterm support downgrade (Enterprise+ -> Standard) effective 2026-03-14. We already invoiced full platform fee on INV-99210. Customer wants a credit instead of reissue. Need decision by EOD.

miguel-billing: Pulling the invoice and usage now. Which SOW? Also any reseller in the chain?

elaine-finance: SOW QL-334-A. Reseller is CloudBridge (derek-reseller). Customer said accountants prefer a single credit memo.

billing-bot: Metering export ready: /exports/quantiva_214600.csv

billing-bot: CSV snippet:
```
date,resource,units,charge_usd
2026-01-01,platform_fee,1,60000
2026-02-01,onprem_vcpu_hours,4800,0
2026-03-01,onprem_vcpu_hours,1300,0
2026-03-14,change_event,1,0
```

miguel-billing: Calc: Enterprise+ annual platform fee = $60,000. Standard = $36,000. Annual delta = $24,000. Remaining months from 2026-03-14 to 2027-01-01 ~ 9.6 months => prorated credit = $19,200.

sophie-account: Quantiva asked us to round to nearest $100 and avoid touching reseller commission accounting. They proposed $19,100 as final.

derek-reseller: If you post a credit that changes the invoice revenue we will likely see commission clawback. We can accept a settlement note that flags "no commission clawback per partner agreement" but need Ops approval.

ian-legal: We can include a release/settlement clause in the memo. Need sign-off from finance lead and partner ops. Also confirm no other contractual triggers (termination/penalty).

manu-cfo: Approved provisional settlement at $19,100. Manu-cfo: signing off contingent on partner ops ack.

miguel-billing: I'll create a provisional credit memo CM-214600-02 for $19,100 and set status=PendingPartnerAck. Notifying partner ops and posting a note on SOW QL-334-A.

derek-reseller: Partner Ops acknowledged, no clawback. Sending internal confirmation.

miguel-billing: Partner Ops ack received. Updating CM-214600-02 to "Final" and posting to AR.

elaine-finance: I'll send the release note to Quantiva with text "Final settlement of platform fee differential due to midterm support tier change; no further claims." Sophie, can you attach to renewal thread?

sophie-account: On it. Email draft attached.

miguel-billing: Done. Credit posted, AR updated, credit memo CM-214600-02 issued. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
